prompt: Some people believe that the fittest and strongest individuals and teams always success in sports. Others think that success in sports depends on mental attitudes. Discuss both views and give your opinions.
essay:
It is often claimed that athletes need to be physically fit to succeed, while others believe that mental strength is more important for controlling their bodies and pursuing their goals. Personally, I believe that both are necessary for sporting success.

On the one hand, physical fitness is essential in various sports to ensure effective competition. Each sport requires specific physical abilities, and if these requirements are not met by the athlete, they might struggle to compete with others at the same level. They may also be prone to injuries if they push their bodies beyond their physical abilities. Therefore, this could hold them back from reaching their goals and achieving a high position in their sport. For example, footballers like Ronaldo, Hazard, and Kaká have suffered from serious injuries throughout their careers, which have obstructed them from competing at their highest level. That is why I believe having a good physique and sufficient strength is vital for athletes, but I think these qualities are not enough on their own to ensure success.

On the other hand, athletes need a strong mentality to reach milestones in their careers. Often, when engaging in a sport, a person has to compete with others who might have various advantages over them. In order not to be intimidated by these advantages, pressure, or difficult circumstances, athletes should remain calm, focused and most importantly, believe in themselves. Even if they fail, they should have the mentality to keep trying and preparing again and again. This applies to winning as well, as many athletes have to put their achievements behind them and start thinking about how to achieve them again. For instance, football manager Pep Guardiola coached Manchester City for about seven years before winning the UEFA Champions League, even though he had reached the final and semi-finals and failed before.

In conclusion, I believe that to succeed in sports, individuals should have a strong mental attitude to cope with any circumstances, as well as good physical fitness and body strength to help them prevent injuries and maintain their performance.
